name: com.unity.2d.tilemap.extras
description:
2D Tilemap Extras is a package that contains extra scripts for use with 2D Tilemap features in Unity. These include custom Tiles and Brushes for the Tilemap feature.

The following are included in the package:
Brushes: GameObject Brush, Group Brush, Line Brush, Random Brush
Tiles: Animated Tile, Auto Tile, Rule Tile, Rule Override Tile
Other: Grid Information, Custom Rules for Rule Tile

samples.description: An example implementation of an Animated Tile.
An example implementation of a Rule Tile with rules matching four-way orthogonal neighbors.
An example implementation of a Rule Tile with rules matching eight-way orthogonal and diagonal neighbors.
An example implementation of Auto Tiles with 3x3 mask and a template.

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- [AutoTileEditor] Add asset preview for AutoTile

### Fixed
- [GameObjectBrush] Only destroy HideAndDontSave objects set in GameObjectBrush for GameObjectBrush.Reset

### Changed
- [AutoTileEditor] Limit number of textures for AutoTile to 0-1000
- [AdvancedRuleOverrideTileEditor] Add scrolling to Rules
- [GameObjectBrush] Set minimum of each size element to 1
- [RandomBrushEditor] Cap each random Set Size element to 100 and total size to 10000
- [RandomBrushEditor] Add dialog box to confirm changes if total Tile count exceeds 100000
- [RandomBrushEditor] Set minimum of Number of Sets to 1
- [RuleTile] Optimise GetTileAnimationData to skip rule matching when no TilingRule has Animation output.
- [RuleTile] Fix matching for GetTileAnimationData to stop at exact rule matched.
